{"task_id":"hard-dev-001","benchmark_id":"hard_local","input":{"instruction":"Settle the order in integer cents. Ignore cancelled lines entirely. For every other line, billed quantity is quantity minus returned. Sum billed quantity times unit_cents to obtain subtotal_cents. If subtotal_cents is at least discount_threshold_cents, discount_cents is floor(subtotal_cents * discount_bps / 10000); otherwise it is zero. Subtract the discount before checking free shipping: shipping_cents is zero when that net amount is at least free_shipping_threshold_cents, otherwise charge data.shipping_cents. Tax the net amount plus shipping only if shipping_taxable is true. tax_cents is that taxable amount times tax_bps / 10000 rounded to the nearest integer cent, with exact halves rounded UP. Do not round at any earlier stage except the stated discount floor. total_cents is net plus shipping plus tax. Return only the JSON object with exactly the declared fields and integer types.","data":{"lines":[{"unit_cents":1999,"quantity":4,"returned":1,"cancelled":false},{"unit_cents":2496,"quantity":3,"returned":0,"cancelled":false},{"unit_cents":9999,"quantity":1,"returned":0,"cancelled":true},{"unit_cents":899,"quantity":2,"returned":2,"cancelled":false}],"discount_threshold_cents":10000,"discount_bps":1250,"free_shipping_threshold_cents":12000,"shipping_cents":499,"shipping_taxable":false,"tax_bps":825},"output_format":{"fields":[{"name":"subtotal_cents","type":"integer"},{"name":"discount_cents","type":"integer"},{"name":"shipping_cents","type":"integer"},{"name":"tax_cents","type":"integer"},{"name":"total_cents","type":"integer"}],"allow_extra_fields":false}},"public_metadata":{"source_id":"hard-local-source-hard-dev-001","split":"dev","category":"arithmetic","family":"invoice"}}
